title: Oathbound Weapons
description: Discover a new level of combat with Oathbound Weapons! This mod introduces unique, powerful weapons that grow stronger as you bond with them through battle. Customize and upgrade your oathbound arsenal to suit your playstyle and conquer your foes like neve
body:
Discover a new level of combat with Oathbound Weapons! This mod introduces unique, powerful weapons that grow stronger as you bond with them through battle. Customize and upgrade your oathbound arsenal to suit your playstyle and conquer your foes like never before.

Jei is highly recommended to find recipes.
